# Vehicle efficiency data space

This lesson uses the built-in `mtcars` dataset to ask how fuel efficiency, horsepower, and vehicle weight relate. The coordinates are standardized for comparison; the browser scene is an evidence layer for the R transformation, not a replacement for the underlying analysis.

```{r}
#| echo: true
library(rlearnxr)
set.seed(2026)
cars <- mtcars
cars$label <- rownames(cars)
scene <- data.frame(
  label = cars$label,
  x = as.numeric(scale(cars$mpg)),
  y = as.numeric(scale(cars$hp)),
  z = as.numeric(scale(cars$wt))
)
render_scene(scene, "x", "y", "z", labels = scene$label,
  output_dir = "scene", title = "mtcars efficiency data space", overwrite = TRUE)
```
